items.title: 6.9.3 Solution ki enthalpy tabdeeli ka hisab (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.9.3, printed pages 133-134, with Sample problem 6.8.

blocks.text: Enthalpy cycle bana kar aur Hess’ law laga kar hum enthalpy change of solution ya enthalpy change of hydration nikal sakte hain (Figure 6.7).

blocks.alt: Teen halke neele dabbon ka energy tikon: 'gaseous ions' (oopar baen), 'ionic solid' (oopar daen) aur 'ions in aqueous solution' (neeche). Gaseous ions se ionic solid: lattice energy, delta H(o)latt. Gaseous ions se aqueous solution ke ions: cation aur anion ki enthalpy change of hydration, delta H(o)hyd. Ionic solid se aqueous solution ke ions: enthalpy change of solution, delta H(o)sol. Surkh dashed teer bil-wasta (indirect) raste ke gird ghoomta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.7: Hess ke qanoon se ionic solid ke aqueous solution banne ka energy cycle (kitab ki Figure 6.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gaseous ions se aqueous ions tak do raste hain: (1) seedha, hydration se (ΔH°hyd); (2) pehle ionic solid banta hai (ΔH°latt), phir solid ghulta hai (ΔH°sol). Dono raste ek hi jagah pohanchte hain, is liye ΔH°latt + ΔH°sol = ΔH°hyd.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 6.7 mein ionic solid se aqueous ions wale teer par 'ΔH°hyd' chhapa hai, halanke saath 'enthalpy change of solution' likha hai. Sahi label ΔH°sol hai, jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.

blocks.title: Sample problem 6.8
blocks.problem:
Neeche diye gaye data se sodium fluoride (NaF) ki enthalpy change of solution (ΔH°sol) nikalein:
NaF ki lattice energy = –902 kJ mol⁻¹
Na⁺ ki heat of hydration = –406 kJ mol⁻¹
F⁻ ki heat of hydration = –506 kJ mol⁻¹
steps: Qadam 2: ΔH°latt + ΔH°sol = ΔH°hyd ko ΔH°sol ke liye likhein: ΔH°sol = ΔH°hyd – ΔH°latt
ΔH°hyd = Na⁺ aur F⁻ dono ka jama = (–406) + (–506) = –912 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab sawal mein '(ΔH°hyd of sodium fluoride' aur jawab mein 'ΔH°hyd [NaF] = –10' likhti hai, aur Qadam 2 mein sirf 'find Δ'. Jo cheez poochi aur nikali gai hai woh enthalpy change of solution hai: ΔH°sol [NaF] = –10 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.alt: Sodium fluoride ka enthalpy cycle: Na+(g) + F-(g) se NaF(s), delta H(o)latt = -902 kJ mol-1; Na+(g) + F-(g) se Na+(aq) + F-(aq) (+aq), delta H(o)hyd [Na+] = -406 aur delta H(o)hyd [F-] = -506 kJ mol-1; NaF(s) se Na+(aq) + F-(aq), delta H(o)sol. Surkh dashed teer bil-wasta rasta dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Sodium fluoride ka enthalpy cycle (Sample Problem 6.8, Step 1) (kitab ke safha 134 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: NaCl ki lattice energy –787 kJ mol⁻¹ hai, aur Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ ki hydration enthalpies –406 aur –364 kJ mol⁻¹ hain. ΔH°sol nikalein aur Table 6.2 se muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: ΔH°sol = ΔH°hyd – ΔH°latt = (–406 – 364) – (–787) = –770 + 787 = +17 kJ mol⁻¹. Table ki value (4.98 kJ mol⁻¹) ki tarah yeh bhi musbat (endothermic) hai; farq data ki wajah se hai, magar nishan sahi hai.

items: Energy cycle: ΔH°latt + ΔH°sol = ΔH°hyd, yani ΔH°sol = ΔH°hyd – ΔH°latt.
